facts.claim: Voyager of the Seas (Royal Caribbean): Entered service 1999; 142,000 GT; 3250 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 323 m length; Voyager class.

Voyager of the Seas is packed with more ways to play on your getaway. Catch a wave on the FlowRider surf simulator. Take a flavor-filled journey to the exotic Far East and find your element with rustic Italian dishes served with a contemporary flair.
The amped up Voyager of the Seas® is packed with more ways to play.
Voyager of the Seas is the lead ship of the Voyager class of cruise ships operated by Royal Caribbean International (RCI).

catalogSpecs.description: Voyager-class; cruise ship operated by its listed cruise line; entered service 1999; 142,000 GT; approx. 3,250 guests at double occupancy.
